title: PH_OpenResty CDN 集群 总览

list.name: node
list.label: 节点

query.rawSql: SELECT node FROM scdn.node_inventory FINAL WHERE enabled=1 ORDER BY node

list.definition: SELECT node FROM scdn.node_inventory FINAL WHERE enabled=1 ORDER BY node

list.name: site
list.label: 站点

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT arrayJoin(arrayConcat(sites,['__unregistered__'])) AS site FROM scdn.node_samples ORDER BY site

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT arrayJoin(arrayConcat(sites,['__unregistered__'])) AS site FROM scdn.node_samples ORDER BY site

list.name: country
list.label: 国家/地区

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM (SELECT country FROM scdn.access UNION ALL SELECT 'ZZ' AS country) ORDER BY country

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM (SELECT country FROM scdn.access UNION ALL SELECT 'ZZ' AS country) ORDER BY country

list.name: scope
list.label: 请求范围
list.query: 公网请求 : public,全部请求（含内网/测试） : all

panels.title: 总节点数
panels.description: 已登记的 CDN 节点；Master 不计入边缘节点。

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM scdn.node_inventory FINAL WHERE enabled=1 AND node IN (${node:singlequote})

panels.title: 在线健康节点
panels.description: 最近 60 秒采集成功且原生 Sync applied / business_health passed。

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND sync_ok=1) AS value FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(sync_ok,time) sync_ok,argMax(sites,time) sites,argMax(ban_records,time) records,argMax(cpu_pct,time) cpu,argMax(mem_pct,time) memory,argMax(cache_disk_pct,time) disk FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node)

panels.title: 总站点数
panels.description: 按启用的站点 ID 在节点间去重，含 demo.local；未登记 Host 不算站点。

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(site) AS value FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(sites) site FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(sync_ok,time) sync_ok,argMax(sites,time) sites,argMax(ban_records,time) records,argMax(cpu_pct,time) cpu,argMax(mem_pct,time) memory,argMax(cache_disk_pct,time) disk FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node)) WHERE site IN (${site:singlequote})

panels.title: 总请求数
panels.description: 所选时间内已完成并写入访问日志的请求；默认排除私网/测试地址。长连接在结束后计入。

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.title: 总拦截数
panels.description: 边缘直接返回 403/429 且未记录上游地址；含域名访问控制。源站 403/429 分开统计，L3 丢包不冒充 HTTP 请求。

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(blocked=1) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.title: 总拉黑 IP 数
panels.description: 所选时间内实际生效的拉黑 IP 去重；集群多节点执行同一 IP 不重复累计。

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExactIf(ip,action='APPLIED' AND applied=1) AS value FROM scdn.bans WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND (scope='*' OR scope IN (${site:singlequote}))

panels.title: 所选时间范围 · 流量与缓存
缓存命中率
panels.description: 可缓存请求中命中/STALE/UPDATING/REVALIDATED 的比例；BYPASS/NONE 不进入分母，无样本显示 —。

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0*countIf(cache IN ('HIT','STALE','UPDATING','REVALIDATED'))/nullIf(countIf(cache IN ('HIT','MISS','EXPIRED','STALE','UPDATING','REVALIDATED')),0) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.title: 总流量 · 下行正文
panels.description: 真实发送的响应正文流量，包含压缩后字节；不含响应头、TLS/QUIC/IP 封装。

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(bytes) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.title: 缓存流量
panels.description: 边缘缓存返回的响应正文字节，按每次请求实际发送量累计。

targets.rawSql: SELECT sumIf(bytes,cache IN ('HIT','STALE','UPDATING','REVALIDATED')) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

SELECT uniqExact(ip) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

SELECT 100.0*countIf(status>=500 AND status<600)/nullIf(count(),0) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.title: P95 请求耗时
panels.description: 请求从接收至完成的耗时；流式/长连接包含整个持续时间。

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration_ms) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

SELECT 100.0*sumIf(bytes,cache IN ('HIT','STALE','UPDATING','REVALIDATED'))/nullIf(sum(bytes),0) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.title: 回源代理请求
panels.description: 访问日志记录上游地址的请求；含内部缓存代理层，不能视为精确外部源站连接数。

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(origin_seen=1) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

SELECT 100.0*countIf(protocol='HTTP/3.0')/nullIf(count(),0) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.title: 源站/上游 403
panels.description: 有上游地址的 403，未作为已确认边缘拦截。

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(status=403 AND origin_seen=1) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

panels.title: 独立请求 URI
panels.description: 按 URI 路径去重，不采集查询参数。

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(uri) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

SELECT quantileTDigest(0.99)(duration_ms) AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0)

SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,count()/greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)) AS QPS FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 下行正文带宽 · 总量 / 缓存

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,8*sum(bytes)/greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)) AS `总带宽`,8*sumIf(bytes,cache IN ('HIT','STALE','UPDATING','REVALIDATED'))/greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)) AS `缓存带宽` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,concat(toString(intDiv(status,100)),'xx') AS metric,count() AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY time,metric ORDER BY time

panels.title: 请求耗时 · P50 / P95 / P99

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,quantileTDigest(0.50)(duration_ms) AS P50,quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration_ms) AS P95,quantileTDigest(0.99)(duration_ms) AS P99 FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,cache AS metric,count() AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY time,metric ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,block_reason AS metric,count() AS value FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND blocked=1 GROUP BY time,metric ORDER BY time

panels.title: 状态码、协议与缓存分层

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(status) AS `状态码`,count() AS `请求数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节`,round(avg(duration_ms),2) AS `平均耗时_ms` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY status ORDER BY `请求数` DESC

SELECT protocol AS `协议`,count() AS `请求数` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY protocol ORDER BY `请求数` DESC

panels.title: L1 / L2 / 回源 / 绕过分布

targets.rawSql: SELECT cache_layer AS `缓存层`,cache AS `缓存状态`,count() AS `请求数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY cache_layer,cache ORDER BY `请求数` DESC

SELECT method AS `方法`,count() AS `请求数` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY method ORDER BY `请求数` DESC

SELECT ip AS `请求IP`,count() AS `请求数`,countIf(blocked=1) AS `拦截数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节`,any(country) AS `国家`,any(operator) AS `运营商_ASN机构` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY ip ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT site AS `站点ID`,any(host) AS `域名`,count() AS `请求数`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND site!='__unregistered__' GROUP BY site ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT uri AS `URI路径`,count() AS `请求数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节`,round(quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration_ms),2) AS P95_ms FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY uri ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ip AS `请求IP`,count() AS `拦截数`,any(country) AS `国家`,any(operator) AS `运营商_ASN机构` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) AND blocked=1 GROUP BY ip ORDER BY `拦截数` DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: 请求 IP 地理、ASN 与运营商
请求 IP 地理位置数量统计
panels.description: 基于现有 Loyalsoldier 国家库；不包含省市、经纬度，PRIVATE/ZZ 单独保留。

targets.rawSql: SELECT country AS `国家_地区代码`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP数`,count() AS `请求数`,countIf(blocked=1) AS `拦截数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY country ORDER BY `请求数` DESC

panels.title: 请求 IP ASN 统计

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat('AS',toString(asn)) AS ASN,any(asn_org) AS `ASN机构`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP数`,count() AS `请求数`,countIf(blocked=1) AS `拦截数` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY asn ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: 请求 IP 运营商统计
panels.description: 按 ASN 组织名称归类中国电信/联通/移动等；无法确认时使用原始 ASN 机构名，不冒充独立 ISP 数据库。

targets.rawSql: SELECT operator AS `运营商_ASN机构`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP数`,count() AS `请求数`,sum(bytes) AS `正文流量_字节` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY operator ORDER BY `请求数` DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT concat('IPv',toString(ip_family)) AS `地址族`,uniqExact(ip) AS `独立IP数`,count() AS `请求数` FROM scdn.access WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) AND site IN (${site:singlequote}) AND country IN (${country:singlequote}) AND (${scope:singlequote}='all' OR internal=0) GROUP BY ip_family

panels.title: 节点 CPU 使用率
panels.description: 来自 /proc 或文件系统；网卡带宽包含主机其他流量，不等同 CDN 正文带宽。

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,node AS metric,avg(cpu_pct) AS value FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY time,node ORDER BY time

panels.title: 节点内存使用率
panels.description: 来自 /proc 或文件系统；网卡带宽包含主机其他流量，不等同 CDN 正文带宽。

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,node AS metric,avg(mem_pct) AS value FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY time,node ORDER BY time

panels.title: 节点缓存磁盘使用率
panels.description: 来自 /proc 或文件系统；网卡带宽包含主机其他流量，不等同 CDN 正文带宽。

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,node AS metric,avg(cache_disk_pct) AS value FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY time,node ORDER BY time

panels.title: 节点网卡发送带宽
panels.description: 来自 /proc 或文件系统；网卡带宽包含主机其他流量，不等同 CDN 正文带宽。

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(time,toIntervalSecond(greatest(10,intDiv(${__interval_ms},1000)))) AS time,node AS metric,avg(tx_bps) AS value FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY time,node ORDER BY time

SELECT node AS `节点`,seen AS `最后采集`,if(seen>now()-INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND sync_ok=1,'在线','离线或异常') AS `同步健康`,sites AS `启用站点`,round(cpu,2) AS `CPU_百分比`,round(memory,2) AS `内存_百分比`,round(disk,2) AS `缓存盘_百分比` FROM (SELECT node,max(time) seen,argMax(sync_ok,time) sync_ok,argMax(sites,time) sites,argMax(ban_records,time) records,argMax(cpu_pct,time) cpu,argMax(mem_pct,time) memory,argMax(cache_disk_pct,time) disk FROM scdn.node_samples WHERE node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node) ORDER BY node

panels.title: 采集进度与历史覆盖
panels.description: 访问日志保留 14 天，封禁记录保留 90 天；实时日志优先，历史归档逐步补入。

targets.rawSql: SELECT node AS `节点`,max(time) AS `最后采集`,argMax(success,time) AS `采集成功`,argMax(completed_files,time) AS `已补齐归档数`,argMax(source_files,time) AS `发现日志文件数`,sum(inserted) AS `本时间段写入行数_含重试`,sum(invalid) AS `无效行数`,argMax(error,time) AS `最近错误` FROM scdn.collection_health WHERE time >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__from}) AND time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(${__to}) AND node IN (${node:singlequote}) GROUP BY node ORDER BY node
